description: Iteration 3 figure: PLG positive control versus LPAL2 for the neutral-rate test, the resolved orangutan stop codon, and ProteomicsDB detection with positive controls
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,3, figsize=(17,5.2))

# --- A: forest plot, nonsynonymous obs/exp against the local neutral rate ---
ax=axes[0]
items=[("PLG  human-chimpanzee", 0.353, 0.14, 0.73, "#2E7D32"),
       ("PLG  human-gorilla",    0.521, 0.24, 0.99, "#2E7D32"),
       ("LPAL2  human-chimpanzee",1.026,0.44, 2.02, "#B3261E"),
       ("LPAL2  human-bonobo",   0.909, 0.37, 1.87, "#B3261E"),
       ("LPAL2  human-gorilla",  1.127, 0.57, 1.99, "#B3261E")]
for i,(lab,v,lo,hi,c) in enumerate(items):
    ax.plot([lo,hi],[i,i], color=c, lw=2.5)
    ax.plot(v, i, "o", color=c, ms=8)
ax.axvline(1.0, color="0.4", ls="--", lw=1)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(items))); ax.set_yticklabels([x[0] for x in items], fontsize=9)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlim(0,2.2)
ax.set_xlabel("nonsynonymous substitutions, observed / expected at the local intronic rate")
ax.set_title("A. The test detects purifying selection on PLG\n    and finds none on LPAL2", loc="left", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
ax.text(1.03, 4.6, "neutral", color="0.4", fontsize=8)
for sp in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# --- B: first in-frame stop across great apes, orangutan now resolved ---
ax=axes[1]
sp=["Homo sapiens","Pan troglodytes","Pan paniscus","Gorilla gorilla","Pongo abelii"]
first=[223,223,223,223,166]
cols=["#B3261E"]*4+["#7B1FA2"]
ax.barh(range(5), first, color=cols)
ax.barh(range(5), [731//3-f for f in first], left=first, color="0.88")
for i,f in enumerate(first):
    ax.text(f+3, i, f"stop at codon {f}", va="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(5)); ax.set_yticklabels(sp, fontsize=9, style="italic")
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlim(0,243); ax.set_xlabel("codon position in the 731 nt exon 1-5 frame")
ax.set_title("B. Orangutan gap closed by pairwise LASTZ_NET:\n    its own TAG at codon 166 (human TGG, Trp)", loc="left", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
ax.text(2,4.75,"purple = independent stop in an exon with zero indels; grey = frame already terminated",
        fontsize=7.5, color="0.35")
for s_ in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s_].set_visible(False)

# --- C: ProteomicsDB detection ---
ax=axes[2]
names=["LPAL2\nQ16609","apo(a)\nP08519","plasminogen\nP00747","HBB\nP68871","albumin\nP02768"]
n=[0,44,70,71,79]
ax.bar(names, n, color=["#B3261E"]+["#1F6FEB"]*4)
for i,v in enumerate(n): ax.text(i, v+1.5, str(v), ha="center", fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel("tissues and fluids with mass-spectrometry records")
ax.set_title("C. ProteomicsDB: zero MS records for Q16609\n    while all four positive controls return data", loc="left", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=8)
for s_ in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s_].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

pd.DataFrame([dict(label=l, obs_exp=v, ci_lo=lo, ci_hi=hi) for l,v,lo,hi,_ in items]).to_csv(
    os.path.join(os.getcwd(),"LPAL2_PLG_obsexp_forest.csv"), index=False)
print("saved LPAL2_PLG_obsexp_forest.csv")
